technology_name: Spice-Fortified Coconut and Palm Sap Syrup Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for functional syrup products that offer digestive benefits and soothe coughs.
description: A process to produce spices fortified syrup by concentrating the sap of coconut or palmyra palm. The sap is fortified with spices and liquid glucose using equipment such as a jacketed kettle, crusher, and centrifuge.
applications: Production of specialized health and functional culinary syrups ,Manufacturing of ingredient bases for instant traditional coffees ,Processing of value-added coconut and palmyra palm sap products ,Formulation of natural herbal-fortified sweetening agents
